headline: Ethereum leads TVL at $54.2B on 2026-10-06 amid stablecoin depegs
summary: Ethereum holds the top position in chain TVL at $54.2 billion, followed by Solana and Base. Stablecoin supply is dominated by USDT at $184.1 billion and USDC at $74.2 billion, with several peg deviations reported. DEX volumes show 1inch Aqua and Uniswap V4 leading daily activity, while L2 TVS is highest on Base and Arbitrum. Multiple security incidents occurred in the prior 14 days, including a $387 million hot wallet compromise at Bitget.

bullets: Ethereum ranks first with $54.2 billion TVL.
Solana holds second place at $6.79 billion TVL.
Base is third at $6.45 billion TVL, ahead of BSC and Tron.
